name: Shikimori Uta
source:
"The Only Child and Mechanic Girl"
Hobbies: Tinkering with mechanics

A first-year girl and the mechanical girl of the Spy Club. She often designs all kinds of weapons for the other members of the Spy Club, such as rocket launchers and wire injection guns. Loves to eat especially [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oden]oden.[/url] Though Uta is a shy girl, she has admitted that she loves spending time in the club room.

"Anzu-senpai, freeze?"

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=689783]The Getchu site[/url]]
